timeline.body:
Fixes #96768 

A fix proposal based on the [identified root cause](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/96768#issuecomment-1609907429).

The problem in general is that mapping properties parsing is affected by the `subobjects` setting, so if multiple mappings are merged, whenever explicit `subobjects` setting is encountered, formerly parsed mappings become invalid.
What I tried in this PR is to re-parse mappings when explicit `subobjects` setting is encountered while merging mapping components. There are potentially better approaches to this.

If this fix proposal is evaluated as a valid path, we still need to:
- [ ] add javadoc
- [ ] add unit tests (e.g. different order of components in composedOf list; test merge in chunks and not in a single list)
- [ ] polish the new `MapperService#merge()` method and see how we minimize re-parsing

timeline.body: Hi @eyalkoren, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
We probably don't need this as the current mapper already has the correct `subobjects` setting.

Note to reviewer: this was formerly within the `synchronized` block but I assume that parsing doesn't really need to be synchronized and as far as I could tell it does seem to be safe to leave it out, but please take another look.

reply.body:
Some `DataStreamIT` tests failure made me see that mapping parsing is not really a stateless operation as I initially thought. At least when it invokes [`metadataMappersSupplier.get()`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/fdcecd9031521d9ffb08bea53097e232e48f5a80/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/MappingParser.java#L104), it actually uses [`MapperService.getMetadataMappers()`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/fdcecd9031521d9ffb08bea53097e232e48f5a80/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/MapperService.java#L210-L232), which is stateful as it depends on the `MapperService#mapper` field, which is being set every time [`MapperService.merge()`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/fdcecd9031521d9ffb08bea53097e232e48f5a80/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/MapperService.java#L369) is invoked.
Therefore, not only I cannot extract mapping parsing outside of the `synchronized` block, it is logically incorrect to first parse all mappings and then merge them one-by-one.
So I'll close this PR and think of a different approach...

timeline.body:
The current approach [cannot work](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/97199/files#r1249541239), unless the mapping parsing logic is changed to be fully stateless, which seems to be a risky thing to attempt to do.
So I am closing this one and think of an alternative approach...
